Mitchell, 5th, and E. Cronk, 8th, also ran well, and if we had made it 4 to score we would have won with 17 points against the School's 19, but with 7 to score the points were: Wandsworth School, 49 ; Belgrave H., 56.
Jones win the 100 yards, with Bellenger in second place, and these two were also first home in the 220 yards. E. Cronk won the 660 yards Junior Race, with R.
These were held at Battersea Park Track on May 9th, and our only placing was E. Cronk, who ran well to get 3rd in the 880 yards.
… flooded in places, it was decided to carry on with the meeting. In our Club 880 yds. handicap we saw our young member, E. Cronk, off 70 yds., score a good win in the fast time of 1 min. 54.7 secs.…
Cobden won easily in 54.4 secs., with E.
Pettican was 2nd and E.Cronk 3rd. The handicap in conjunction was won by Edgar.
